scope: Phase-two second batch: shared object selection, registered object creation and deletion, automatic portals, dependency option ownership and copied batch inputs/results. SDK sources unchanged.
status: This batch implemented and validated, including selection retry after a refused draft. Phase two remains in progress; completed_phase stays one.
implemented: ObjectSelection owns selected references, derived native IDs, lock and revision. SelectionCommands provides replace/invert/clear/lock/restore and a native-independent read-only projection.
Existing toolbar, keys and Level Manager creation/deletion entry points call registered commands; object queries and mutation remain in the native object feature.
Nine layout creators, Scene/Group/Place/Array creation, batch Script creation/deletion, scene/group removal and both automatic portal operations reuse existing core operations.

Document edits keep a single undo step, including nested external commands and rollback after a module creates/renames then throws. Native object destruction keeps history clearing and refuses open edits/read-only/wrong-thread/stale requests.

Delete dependency options moved out of EditorState into ObjectCommands. Dialogs hold copied drafts and lifetime-bearing targets. Unknown flag bits, short class arrays and values above CKDWORD are refused before mutation.
Deletion and export have distinct target containers. Delete prompts, Explorer cancellation and the automatic-portal picker preserve native object lifetimes.

Public version-three values include copied object/integer arrays; objects are revalidated at dispatch. Text remains bounded to 1 MiB and arrays separately to 64 MiB; a 50000-reference selection regression covers batching beyond the text limit.
EditorApplication retains generic completed fields, accessible through application.operation-output, without another result table or callbacks to closed views.
remaining: Phase two: object/NMS and resource file operations, runtime controls, webpage/print operation ownership and outstanding document replacement combinations.
Phases three to five: view instances and local input routing, graph selection/navigation, specialized parameter creation, curve tools and remaining native-backed UI queries.
Phase six: production module discovery/packaging, configuration persistence, missing sample/platform execution and remaining viewport counters/multi-viewport measurements.

checks.build: Complete macos-arm64 Release build passed: production editor, core tests, native UI test program and independent modules.

module_ui_inventory.note: Unselected Test Engine cases are not counted as passed. CTest sample suites are reported separately as skips.

regressions: Batch object/integer data remains owned after the caller changes its buffers; deferred results retain created Script references.
A native slot reused after queueing invalidates the whole deletion batch before any target is destroyed or history cleared.
Read-only, wrong-thread, malformed/oversized arrays and invalid deletion dependencies fail without document/history changes.
Selection lock/refusal and readonly/busy projection preserve Dirty/Undo; large selections are deduplicated without truncation.
Script deletion, scene/group removal and automatic portals retain their existing undo/no-change behavior.
External creation provider runs through the actual default 3D creation key and creates/renames in one undo step.
A stale Delete Options dialog cannot delete a same-ID replacement; the actual native UI regression passed.
A 50000-reference selection with distinct first/last objects retains both; a refused draft selection is retried after the draft ends.
checks.public_headers: Independent C11/C++17 consumers passed. Public descriptors and array spans expose no STL/SDK/SDL/ImGui types; the separate drawing adapter remains explicit.
checks.native_files: NeMoDevSdkObjectBehavior, CompositionReadCompatibility, ObjectFileOpen and open_nmo_populates_level_manager_as_new_import passed. Original-sample suites remain skipped.
checks.sdk: SDK revisions, source patch hashes and runtime hashes match the accepted phase-one capture. No SDK source changes in this batch; no new full SDK success is claimed.
remaining: 15 original-sample UI suites are absent and skipped.
Windows/Linux execution not performed on this macOS host.

selection_retry.symptom: A draft rejects the shared selection update; ending the draft must allow the same local selection to be submitted again. AppTests.cpp reproduced the missed retry before the fix.
selection_retry.fix: SelectionFollower records acceptance after dispatch; locked-selection local behavior is retained.
selection_retry.result: Failing UI assertion reproduced before the fix; complete final CTest run and six independent module UI cases passed after it.
